from glom import core
constants = core
consts = core  # deprecated alias, use constants instead


def __getattr__(name):
    """Provide backward compatibility access to consts."""
    if name == 'consts':
        import warnings
        warnings.warn("glom.consts is deprecated, use glom.constants instead",

        return core
    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")
